### Global Metadata
A complete 90-second romantic, bittersweet summer-night piece for watching fireworks with someone on a riverbank, in the spirit of a Makoto Shinkai film. 70 BPM, E-flat major. A tender piano melody, soft acoustic guitar arpeggios, warm legato strings, a solo cello counter-melody, light glockenspiel and soft timpani swells. Pure instrumental ensemble piece.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: piano sings the melody and the cello answers it; strings swell under the fireworks.

### Timed Arrangement
0-18 seconds: solo piano and guitar arpeggios, quiet and warm. 18-48 seconds: the piano theme with strings entering, cello counter-melody. 48-72 seconds: a gentle swell with timpani and glockenspiel like fireworks blooming. 72-90 seconds: back to piano and guitar, tender. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 90 seconds and must not end early, ending cleanly on the tonic so it can loop.
